verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an autonomous agent with a configurable low/medium/high reasoning-effort setting. The closest features are adjacent and earn no credit: `mode=auto` picks the cheapest proxy/rendering configuration that succeeds, and the ChatGPT/Gemini pass-through APIs expose no effort parameter. The axis is still fair for an AI-enabled data-gathering service, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
